pricing.faqBillingQ: How does billing work for 12 and 24-month plans?
pricing.faqBillingA: The full term is billed once at checkout at the discounted effective monthly rate. That is how we lock in your dedicated server for the whole contract. Included usage (voice minutes, SMS, AI budget) still resets every month.
pricing.faqTermEndQ: What happens when my term ends?
pricing.faqTermEndA: Service continues month-to-month at the renewal rate shown on your plan card (for example, {starterRenewal} for Starter or {standardRenewal} for Standard after a 24-month term), unless you start a new contract at the contract rate.
pricing.faqCarrierFeeQ: What is the one-time {carrierFee} carrier registration fee?
pricing.faqCarrierFeeA: US carriers require every business that sends text messages to register (10DLC brand and campaign registration). We pass this one-time {carrierFee} fee through at cost. It is charged once at signup and is non-refundable, since carriers do not refund it to us.
pricing.faqGuaranteeA: Yes. Plans have a 30-day money-back window from the initial purchase date. The one-time carrier registration fee is excluded, because carriers do not refund it, and usage charges you have already incurred (texts sent and received, call minutes, AI usage) are deducted at cost, because our carriers and AI providers bill us for them. Usage packs added to a membership are non-refundable: the pack charge is excluded from the refund, remaining pack credits are removed, and usage a pack already covered is not deducted again. Enterprise deployments provisioned on Canadian-region infrastructure or on customer-supplied servers are not covered by this guarantee; any refund rights for those deployments are set out in the enterprise agreement or order form.
pricing.faqCanadaFeeQ: What is the {canadaFeeMonthly}/mo Canadian messaging surcharge?
pricing.faqCanadaFeeA: Canadian mobile carriers (Bell, Rogers, Telus, and others) charge per-message fees for business texting that US carriers structure differently. Canadian-based businesses pay a flat {canadaFeeMonthly}/mo surcharge that covers these carrier pass-through fees, so your coworker can text your Canadian customers with no per-message surprises. It appears as its own line item at checkout and renews with your plan; US-based businesses never pay it.
pricing.faqMexicoFeeQ: What is the {mexicoFeeMonthly}/mo Mexican messaging surcharge?
pricing.faqMexicoFeeA: Your AI coworker answers on a US phone number, and texting or calling +52 numbers from it rides international carrier rates. Mexico-based businesses pay a flat {mexicoFeeMonthly}/mo surcharge that covers those rates with no per-message surprises, the one-time US carrier registration fee is waived (it only applies to US texting), and SMS to customers includes up to {mexicoSmsCap} messages per month. WhatsApp is the recommended channel for customer conversations in Mexico: connect your own WhatsApp Business account and your coworker uses it at no per-message charge from us. The surcharge appears as its own line item at checkout and renews with your plan; US-based businesses never pay it.
pricing.faqKeepNumberQ: Can I keep my existing business number?
pricing.faqKeepNumberA: Yes. Standard and Enterprise plans support bring-your-own-number: we port your existing number in and your coworker answers on it. Every plan also includes a dedicated number out of the box.
pricing.faqExtraNumbersQ: Can I get more than one phone number?
pricing.faqExtraNumbersA: Every plan includes one dedicated number. Extra numbers are $5/mo each. Contact <email>{contactEmail}</email> to add one to your account.
pricing.faqUsageCapsQ: What happens if I use up my included voice minutes or SMS?
pricing.faqUsageCapsA: Your coworker stops placing metered voice calls or sending customer texts once the monthly cap is reached, and you get an alert well before that happens. Caps reset every month, and you can upgrade your plan at any time from the dashboard. You can also buy one-time voice minute, SMS, or AI chat top-up packs from Dashboard → Billing without upgrading, or add discounted recurring packs when you start or change a membership (5% month-to-month, 10% on 12-month, 20% on 24-month; they renew with your plan). Usage packs are non-refundable. Bonus usage is consumed after your included monthly allowance and lasts until the end of your billing period or 30 days from purchase, whichever is later.
pricing.faqWhiteGloveA: Two one-time packages: White-glove setup covers guided setup, number porting, and a live 1:1 training call; White-glove buildout adds everything in setup plus a full custom AiFlow buildout. Both include 30 days of priority phone and video support. Tell us you're interested and a specialist will reach out.

faqPage.metaDescription: Frequently asked questions about New Coworker: how the AI employee works, setup, number porting, privacy, billing, usage limits, and support.
faqPage.ogDescription: How New Coworker works: setup, porting, privacy, billing, limits, and support.
faqPage.heroSubtitle: Everything owners ask before hiring their New Coworker. Something missing? Email us and a human replies.
faqPage.whatIsA: New Coworker is a 24/7 AI employee for your business. It answers your business phone with human-level conversation, replies to texts and emails, books appointments on your calendar, qualifies leads, and remembers every customer, all monitored from a dashboard you control.
faqPage.differentQ: How is this different from an answering service or a chatbot?
faqPage.differentA: An answering service takes messages; a chatbot follows scripts. Your coworker actually handles the interaction: it answers questions from your business's real knowledge, books appointments mid-call, sends follow-up texts and emails, and runs automated workflows. It also has permanent, lossless memory, so context builds instead of resetting every conversation.
faqPage.knowledgeQ: What does my coworker know about my business?
faqPage.knowledgeA: During onboarding you answer a short questionnaire, and your coworker can read your website to learn your services, pricing, and policies. From then on it learns from every conversation. You can review and edit its memory anytime from the dashboard.
faqPage.transfersQ: Can it transfer calls to me or my team?
faqPage.transfersA: Yes. Standard plans include warm handoff transfers: when a caller needs a human, your coworker brings you onto the line with the context already gathered, so the caller never repeats themselves.
faqPage.bookQ: Can an AI actually book appointments, or does it just take a message?
faqPage.bookA: It books. Your coworker checks live availability on your real calendar (Google Calendar, Microsoft 365, CalDAV, Calendly, or Vagaro), offers times, and writes the appointment while the caller is still on the phone. If you have no calendar tool at all, it books on a scheduling page we host for you, and everyone gets a confirmation and a reminder.
faqPage.channelsQ: Does it handle texts and DMs, or only phone calls?
faqPage.channelsA: Both. The same coworker answers calls, two-way SMS, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram DMs, and website chat, and it gets its own email address. It is one memory across all of them, so a customer who called on Tuesday and texts on Friday does not have to start over.
faqPage.languagesQ: Can it talk to my Spanish-speaking customers?
faqPage.languagesA: Yes. It detects the language a customer uses and replies in it, on calls and in messages, and remembers that preference for next time. It can also stay on a transferred call and interpret between your staff member and the caller in real time. Your own dashboard can be in English or Spanish, independently.
faqPage.setupTimeA: Minutes. After checkout, provisioning is fully automated: your dedicated server, phone number, and email are created, and your coworker is trained from your questionnaire and website. No IT project, no sales call required.
faqPage.keepNumberQ: Can I keep my existing business number?
faqPage.keepNumberA: Yes. Standard and Enterprise plans support bring-your-own-number porting. We handle the port and your coworker answers on your existing number. Every plan also includes a dedicated number that works from day one.
faqPage.whiteGloveQ: Can someone set everything up for me?
faqPage.whiteGloveA: Yes. White-glove setup ($750) gets you a specialist who configures everything live with you, handles number porting, and trains you 1:1. White-glove buildout ($2,000) adds a full custom workflow buildout. Both include 30 days of priority phone and video support. See pricing for details.
faqPage.whiteGlovePlain: Yes. White-glove setup ($750) gets you a specialist who configures everything live with you, handles number porting, and trains you 1:1. White-glove buildout ($2,000) adds a full custom workflow buildout. Both include 30 days of priority phone and video support.
faqPage.carrierFeeQ: What is the one-time {carrierFee} carrier registration fee?
faqPage.carrierFeeA: US carriers require every business that sends text messages to complete 10DLC registration. We pass this one-time fee through at cost. It is charged at signup and is non-refundable because carriers do not refund it to us.
faqPage.readyQ: What do I need to have ready before it can start?
faqPage.readyA: Your business name, what you sell, your hours, and your website address. Onboarding crawls the site once to learn your services, and you can correct anything it got wrong afterward. A dedicated phone number is included, so you do not have to change your existing line to try it.
faqPage.dataA: Your AI coworker runs on a private server dedicated to your business, with its own credentials and a deny-by-default security posture. Conversations and business records are stored securely in our platform database, isolated per business and never shared with other businesses, and you can export your data at any time.
faqPage.trainingQ: Is my customer data used to train AI models?
faqPage.trainingA: No. Your coworker's memory belongs to your business and is used only to serve your customers. We follow a deny-by-default security posture with per-business credentials throughout the platform.
faqPage.complianceA: Compliance guardrails are enforced in every conversation, including Fair Housing Act rules for real estate, and Enterprise plans support custom compliance modules for other regulated industries.

Enterprise is custom and adds branded RCS messaging. faqPage.vsHiringA: By a wide margin on cost: plans start at {starterPrice}, against roughly a couple of thousand dollars a month for part-time help that still goes home at five. The honest trade is judgment. A person handles the awkward call better, which is why your coworker transfers to one whenever the caller asks or the conversation needs it.
faqPage.upfrontQ: Why is the full term billed upfront on 12 and 24-month plans?
faqPage.upfrontA: Because your plan includes a dedicated private server that we prepay for your whole contract. Billing the term once is what makes the discounted monthly rate possible. Monthly plans are billed month-to-month.
faqPage.cancelA: Yes. Plans have a 30-day money-back window from the initial purchase date (the one-time carrier registration fee is excluded, usage charges already incurred, such as texts sent and received, call minutes, and AI usage, are deducted at cost, and usage pack add-ons are non-refundable and excluded). Enterprise deployments on Canadian-region or customer-supplied infrastructure are covered by their enterprise agreement instead. After the term, service continues month-to-month at the renewal rate unless you start a new contract.
faqPage.capsQ: What happens if I hit my monthly usage caps?
faqPage.capsA: Included usage resets monthly: for example, Standard includes {standardVoice} and {standardSms} texts per month (a long message counts as several texts, one per 160 characters). You're alerted before you run out; at the cap, metered voice calls and customer texts pause until the next cycle or an upgrade. You can also buy one-time voice minute, SMS, or AI chat top-up packs from Dashboard → Billing without upgrading, or add discounted recurring packs when you start or change a membership (5% month-to-month, 10% on 12-month, 20% on 24-month; they renew with your plan). Usage packs are non-refundable. Bonus usage is consumed after your included monthly allowance and lasts until the end of your billing period or 30 days from purchase, whichever is later. Compliance messages are never blocked.
faqPage.supportA: Starter includes email support; Standard includes priority email support; Enterprise includes an SLA with dedicated support. Live call/video support is available through the white-glove onboarding packages.

zoomPage.ogDescription: Connect Zoom so your AI coworker schedules video appointments with Zoom join links, and keeps them updated when plans change.
zoomPage.heroSubtitle: Connect Zoom once and every video appointment your coworker books comes with a Zoom meeting and a join link the customer receives automatically, kept in sync through reschedules and cancellations.
zoomPage.marketplaceBadge: Available on the Zoom App Marketplace
zoomPage.card1Body: When a customer books a video appointment by phone, SMS, email, or web chat, your coworker creates a scheduled Zoom meeting on your account for that exact time slot.
zoomPage.card2Body: The meeting's join link rides along in the booking confirmation your customer receives and in the calendar event's description, so nobody hunts for the link.
zoomPage.card3Title: Kept in sync, end to end
zoomPage.card3Body: If the appointment is rescheduled, the Zoom meeting moves with it. If it's canceled, the meeting is deleted. No orphaned meetings on your account.
zoomPage.card4Body: Cloud-record a meeting with audio transcript on and, once Zoom finishes processing it, your coworker imports the transcript and condenses it into minutes in your document library, staff-only by default. Automatic import is on by default and has one switch to turn it off on the Zoom card; you can also import any meeting on demand by pasting its meeting ID or recording link into Dashboard → Integrations → Zoom → Meeting minutes.
zoomPage.prereqNote: Prerequisites: a New Coworker subscription with a connected calendar (Google, Microsoft 365, or CalDAV) and a Zoom account. Zoom meeting creation applies to appointments your coworker books directly on those calendars.
zoomPage.setupSubtitle: Connecting takes under a minute from your dashboard.
zoomPage.step1Body: Sign in at newcoworker.com, open <link>Dashboard → Integrations → Zoom</link>.
zoomPage.step2Title: Click Connect and approve on Zoom
zoomPage.step2Body: You're sent to Zoom's consent screen listing exactly what New Coworker may do (create, update, and delete meetings on your account). Click Allow. Zoom returns you to your dashboard automatically.
zoomPage.step3Body: The Zoom card now shows the connected account's name and email. From this moment, video appointments your coworker books include a Zoom meeting and join link.
zoomPage.usageSubtitle: There's nothing to operate day-to-day, your coworker does the work. Here's what happens behind the scenes.
zoomPage.booking1: A customer asks for an appointment (by phone, text, email, or web chat). Your coworker finds an open slot on your connected calendar and books it.
zoomPage.booking2: With Zoom connected, the booking gets a scheduled Zoom meeting at that time, titled after the appointment.
zoomPage.booking3: The customer's confirmation message includes the Zoom join link, and the link is written into the calendar event so your team sees it too.
zoomPage.changes1: When a customer reschedules, your coworker moves the calendar event and the Zoom meeting to the new time, same link, no new invite chains.
zoomPage.changes2: When a customer cancels, the meeting is deleted along with the event.
zoomPage.changes3: Zoom is never a point of failure: if Zoom is briefly unreachable, the appointment still books, it just books without a video link.
zoomPage.removalSubtitle: Two ways, both fully disconnect New Coworker from your Zoom account.
zoomPage.removeDash3: We revoke our access token with Zoom and permanently delete the stored credentials. Future bookings simply book without Zoom meetings.
zoomPage.removeZoom1: Sign in to marketplace.zoom.us and open Manage → Added Apps.
zoomPage.removeZoom3: Zoom revokes New Coworker's access immediately. Your dashboard card will show the connection as needing reconnection.
zoomPage.scopesTitle: Exactly what New Coworker can access
zoomPage.scopesSubtitle: The integration requests the minimum Zoom scopes needed to schedule meetings on your behalf and, only when you ask, import a meeting transcript, nothing else.
zoomPage.scopeUse1: Create the Zoom meeting for an appointment your coworker books
zoomPage.scopeUse2: Move the meeting when the appointment is rescheduled
zoomPage.scopeUse3: Delete the meeting when the appointment is canceled
zoomPage.scopeUse5: Create the join link your coworker sends to the customer
zoomPage.scopeUse6: Identify the connected Zoom account (name and email shown on your dashboard card)
zoomPage.scopeUse7: Fetch a cloud-recorded meeting's transcript, automatically after your meetings while auto-import is on, or when you click Import transcript, to produce meeting minutes in your Documents
zoomPage.scopeUse8: Translate a meeting ID you paste into its past-meeting instance (Zoom's transcript lookup needs the instance for instant meetings) and keep imports de-duplicated
zoomPage.scopeUse9: Required by Zoom for the transcript-ready notification that powers automatic minutes; the app makes no other use of it
zoomPage.privacyNote: Your Zoom tokens are encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) in a row-level-security-protected database, are never exposed to the browser, and are deleted when you disconnect. Meeting content is read only to produce meeting minutes in your document library: automatically after your own cloud-recorded meetings while auto-import is enabled (one switch on the Zoom card turns it off), or when you explicitly import one. Everything else touches only the scheduling data for appointments your coworker manages. See our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> for details. Questions? Reach us any time via <contact>newcoworker.com/contact</contact>.

faq1.q: Does Smith.ai use AI or real people?
faq1.a: Both, and that is their strength. Their AI answers, qualifies, and books, and it can escalate to one of more than 500 North America based receptionists, with no extra fee when the AI starts the handoff. New Coworker has no human staff. Our coworker transfers a live call to you or a teammate and texts whoever owns the lead, but if you want a person to pick up when the AI is out of its depth, Smith.ai does that and we do not.

faq2.a: It depends on volume, and their free tier is real. Their AI plan costs nothing for the first 25 calls a month, which beats anything we charge. Past that they meter, at $2.00 or $1.67 a call, and their live receptionists run from $300 a month for 30 calls up to $2,100 for 300, with overage on top. We charge per business, so a busy month costs the same as a quiet one. Short version: they win at very low volume, we win once the phone actually rings.

faq3.q: Can Smith.ai handle my texts and DMs too?
faq3.a: That is the main difference between us. Smith.ai is built around the phone line, and their web chat and outbound campaigns are separate products with their own plans. New Coworker answers calls, texts, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram, email, and website chat with one coworker that remembers the same customer across all of them, on one plan.

cancelConfirmation.adminSubject: Your NewCoworker account has been closed
cancelConfirmation.admin2: Your workspace access has been disabled and account data has been scheduled for immediate wipe.
cancelConfirmation.admin3: Contact support if you believe this was a mistake.
cancelConfirmation.defaultSubject: Your NewCoworker subscription has been canceled
cancelConfirmation.default3: Reactivate anytime from your billing dashboard to restore access before the data-retention window closes.

refundIssued.subject: Your NewCoworker refund is on its way
refundIssued.line1: We've issued a refund of {amount} to your original payment method.
refundIssued.line2: Refunds typically show up in 5–10 business days depending on your bank.
refundIssued.line3: Your workspace has been scheduled for shutdown and we've saved a backup of your data for 30 days in case you decide to come back.
refundIssued.line4: If you have any questions, just reply to this email.

emailVerification.subject: Confirm your NewCoworker email
emailVerification.textIntro: To finish securing your account, please confirm your email address by opening the link below:
emailVerification.textExpiry: This link expires in 7 days. If you didn't create a NewCoworker account, you can safely ignore this email.
emailVerification.htmlIntro: Here's your link to confirm your email for New Coworker. Click the button below, no password needed.
emailVerification.securityNote: If you didn't create a NewCoworker account, you can safely ignore this email. Your account is secure.

teamInvite.subject: You've been added to {businessName} on NewCoworker
teamInvite.added: {invitedBy} added you to {businessName}'s AI coworker dashboard as {role}.
teamInvite.roleManager: As a manager you can run settings, AiFlows, integrations, and the team roster.
teamInvite.roleStaff: As staff you can work the dashboard: messages, calls, and chat.
teamInvite.signIn: Sign in with this email address to get started: {loginUrl}

whiteGloveOffer.subject: Your NewCoworker offer: {offerName}
whiteGloveOffer.line1: We've prepared a custom white-glove offer for you: {offerName}, {price}, one-time.
whiteGloveOffer.afterPay: After payment you'll get an email confirmation and a booking link, and everything follows your account automatically.

whiteGloveIntake.subject: Your NewCoworker white-glove setup questionnaire
whiteGloveIntake.line1: We're getting your white-glove build ready. To set everything up exactly the way you want it, we have a short questionnaire for you, mostly multiple choice, about 5 minutes.
whiteGloveIntake.line2: It covers how your AI assistant should greet new leads, when it follows up, how appointments get booked, and which topics should always go straight to your team.
whiteGloveIntake.line4: Your answers become the build plan our team installs from, so the more accurate they are, the better your assistant will fit your business from day one.

blogNewPost.subject: New on the New Coworker blog: {title}
blogNewPost.intro: We just published a new post on the New Coworker blog.

whiteGloveConfirmation.subject: Your {packageName} is confirmed
whiteGloveConfirmation.line1: Thanks for purchasing {packageName}, a specialist will work with you one-on-one to get your AI coworker fully dialed in.
whiteGloveConfirmation.replyLine: Reply to this email and we'll schedule your onboarding session.
whiteGloveConfirmation.priorityLine: Your priority phone & video support line is open through {date}.

monthlyIntroNudge.subject: A note about your next New Coworker invoice
monthlyIntroNudge.line1: Hi, we wanted to give you a clear notice before your next invoice.
monthlyIntroNudge.line2: Your first-month rate of {introRate} applies through {date}. After that, month-to-month renews at {renewalRate} unless you choose a different plan.
monthlyIntroNudge.line3: If a longer commitment fits better, prepaid contracts are available at a lower monthly rate:
monthlyIntroNudge.line4: No action is required to stay on month-to-month. To review or change your plan, open Billing in your dashboard.

contractTermNudge.subject: A note about your New Coworker contract
contractTermNudge.line1: Hi, we wanted to give you a clear notice before your contract term ends.
contractTermNudge.line2: Your {term} rate of {contractRate} applies through {date}. After that, service continues month-to-month at {renewalRate} unless you renew your contract.
contractTermNudge.line3: Turn on contract auto-renew in Billing to lock in another {term} at {contractRate} ({contractTotal} billed upfront), or start a new contract after the term.
contractTermNudge.line4: No action is required to roll to month-to-month. To review options, open Billing in your dashboard.

prioritySupportNudge.subject: Your priority support is ending soon
prioritySupportNudge.line1: Hi, a quick heads up so nothing catches you by surprise.
prioritySupportNudge.line2: Your priority phone & video support ends on {date}, which is {days} away.
prioritySupportNudge.line3: After that, support continues by email at no extra cost. Nothing else about your plan changes.
prioritySupportNudge.line4: Want to keep the priority line open? Restart it for {price}/month from Billing in your dashboard. You can cancel any time.

autoReload.disabledLine1: Hi, we could not charge your card for an automatic top-up, so auto-reload has been turned off.
autoReload.disabledLine2: Your card was declined {attempts} times in a row for {familyName}. Nothing was charged.
autoReload.disabledLine3: Update your card and turn auto-reload back on from your billing page, and we will pick up where we left off.
autoReload.pausedSubject: Your bank needs to confirm a top-up for {business}
autoReload.pausedLine1: Hi, your bank asked to confirm the last automatic top-up, which we cannot do without you present.
autoReload.pausedLine2: Auto-reload for {familyName} is paused until then. Buy that pack once by hand and auto-reload will resume on its own.
autoReload.limitSubject: Auto-reload hit your monthly limit for {business}
autoReload.limitLine1: Hi, auto-reload reached the monthly limit you set, so it is paused for the rest of this month.
autoReload.limitLine2: This affects {familyName}. Raise the limit on your billing page if you want top-ups to continue.
autoReload.noCardLine1: Hi, we could not use your card for an automatic top-up, so auto-reload has been turned off.
autoReload.noCardLine3: Authorize a card on your billing page and turn auto-reload back on.

notFound.heading: We could not find that page
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the link you followed may have expired. If somebody sent you this link, ask them for a fresh one.

errorPage.heading: Something went wrong on our side
errorPage.body: The page hit an error while loading. It was not anything you did; trying again usually works.
